summary: JinkoSolar filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, announcing its unaudited first-quarter 2026 financial results. The filing covers routine quarterly business and operational highlights—module shipments of 13.7 GW, revenues of RMB12.25 billion, gross profit margin of 8.3%, and a net loss of RMB463.5 million. It contains no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. The press release is purely an earnings report with management commentary on industry position and market conditions. As a foreign private issuer's routine earnings disclosure, it does not constitute a special situation.
